title: Hook response (answer of POST <BASE>/open and <BASE>/touch)
description: The envelope a hook route answers with. An EMPTY 200 body is always valid and means 'nothing to inject, carry on' (fail-open). When the body is non-empty it MUST match this schema: either additionalContext (inform the agent, work continues) or permissionDecision 'deny' (hard mode ONLY, edit refused with a reason). /close always answers an empty 200.

hookEventName.description: Echoes the event that produced the request.

additionalContext.description: Text injected into the agent context: the human-readable verdict (kind, degree, neighbour, path, reason, advice) and any pending notices. Clients MAY also receive the machine-readable verdict (verdict.json) through richer transports.

permissionDecision.description: Hard mode only: refuse the edit. MUST NOT be emitted outside zones the project placed under hard mode.

permissionDecisionReason.description: REQUIRED with permissionDecision 'deny'. Names the neighbour and says what to do instead.
